introSection.heading: Welcome to Banjara Matrimony in Ahmedabad
introSection.content:
Gujarat's largest city and commercial capital, Ahmedabad is home to a well-established Banjara and Vanjara community with roots in trade and transport, and a growing presence in the city's manufacturing, textile and services economy. As the state's economic centre, Ahmedabad draws Vanjara families from Mehsana, Banaskantha, Sabarkantha and the rest of Gujarat for education and work.

BanjaraMatch brings these families together in one place. Whether you live in the old walled city, in the industrial east around Naroda and Vatva, or in the newer western suburbs along SG Highway, you can find a partner who shares your language, customs and values without paying a rupee.

aboutSection.heading: About the Banjara (Vanjara) Community in Ahmedabad
aboutSection.content:
In Gujarat the community is most often called Vanjara, while families elsewhere in India say Banjara, Lambani, Lambadi or Gor. They are one people: historically the caravan traders who carried grain and salt across India, today doctors, engineers, teachers, government employees, transporters and business owners. Read more in our history of the Banjara community.

Ahmedabad's Vanjara families range from long-established trading and transport households to a newer generation in corporate, IT and professional roles. Across all of them, the gotra still matters when a marriage is arranged: families avoid alliances within the same gotra and often check the mother's gotra too. Our Banjara gotra list explains the clans and how they are grouped.

BanjaraMatch connects Ahmedabad's Banjara and Vanjara families with verified, gotra-aware profiles locally and across Gujarat, completely free.
aboutSection.culturalNote: Many Ahmedabad families speak Gujarati and Hindi day to day and Gor Boli (the Banjara language) at home and at family functions.
aboutSection.modernContext: Younger members increasingly study and work in Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar, so most families now look for a partner who is both rooted in the community and settled in a career.

customContentBlocks.title: A Banjara wedding, Ahmedabad style
customContentBlocks.content:
Banjara weddings are colourful, musical and very much a family affair. Elders usually begin by comparing gotras, and once the families agree, the celebrations bring together relatives from across Gujarat and beyond.

  • Traditional dress: brides often wear the embroidered phetiya (skirt) and kanchali (blouse) with mirror work, silver jewellery and an odhni, alongside a modern sari or lehenga.
  • Songs and dance: the women of the family sing traditional wedding songs in Gor Boli, and dancing continues late into the night.
  • Family first: both families meet and talk at length before anything is fixed, which is why we let parents and siblings take part from the very first step.

Planning ahead? Create a shareable marriage biodata in a few minutes.

customContentBlocks.title: Meeting a match safely in Ahmedabad
customContentBlocks.content:
• Chat on BanjaraMatch first and keep personal phone numbers private until you trust the person.
  • Prefer verified profiles with the blue tick, and ask your family to join early conversations.
  • For a first meeting choose a busy public place such as the Sabarmati Riverfront, Kankaria Lake or a mall on SG Highway, and tell someone at home where you are going.
  • Never send money to anyone you met online. Report or block any profile that asks for it.

Read more tips in our FAQ or contact us if something does not feel right.

faqSection.heading: Banjara Matrimony in Ahmedabad: frequently asked questions

faqs.question: Is the community called Banjara or Vanjara in Ahmedabad?
faqs.answer: Vanjara is the more common local name in Gujarat, closely related to Banjara, Lambani and Gor elsewhere in India. BanjaraMatch profiles reflect all of these names.

faqs.question: Is BanjaraMatch free in Ahmedabad?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100% free. There are no hidden charges for registration, browsing, sending interests or chat.

faqs.question: How does BanjaraMatch handle gotra when suggesting matches?
faqs.answer: Profiles from your own gotra are never suggested, following the Banjara custom of marrying outside one's gotra. You can also choose preferred gotras for your partner in your partner preferences.

faqs.question: Can I see matches only from Ahmedabad or Gujarat?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the search filters to look for members in Ahmedabad, or widen the search to Gandhinagar, Vadodara, Surat and the rest of Gujarat. The app's Nearby search shows members within a distance you choose.

faqs.question: Are the profiles verified?
faqs.answer: Members can verify their profile by submitting a government ID and a selfie. Our team reviews each request, and approved profiles show a blue verified tick.

faqs.question: Can parents create a profile for their son or daughter?
faqs.answer: Yes. When you register you can say who manages the profile: the member, a parent, a sibling, a relative or a friend. It is shown on the profile so other families know who they are talking to.

faqs.question: Who can see my phone number and photos?
faqs.answer: You decide. In privacy settings you can show your photos and contact details to everyone, only to your accepted connections, or to nobody.

faqs.question: When can I chat with someone I like?
faqs.answer: Send an interest first. Chat and calls open once the other member accepts, so you only hear from people you have agreed to talk to.

faqs.question: Can NRI families from Ahmedabad register?
faqs.answer: Yes. NRIs can register from any country, keep Ahmedabad or Gujarat as their home town, and search for matches in India and abroad.

faqs.question: Is there a BanjaraMatch mobile app?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Android app lets you search, chat and get match alerts on your phone. See the BanjaraMatch app page for details.
